newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 476.50/477.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 476.50/477.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer at 476.50/477.75 per dollar as overnight bank lending rates fell to 25 percent from 60 percent in the morning, traders said.
On Monday, the unit closed at 476.25/477.25 per dollar.

"There was some interbank selling of dollars in the morning as investors bought up bolivars for the TEM auction -- but that pattern reversed in the afternoon," said one trader. The softer bolivar came despite a 191 basis points rise in benchmark six month TEM yields to 16.24 percent in Tuesday's auction.
